description: This file defines an authentication context provider (`AuthProvider`) for a React application, utilizing Supabase for authentication. It manages sessions, provides methods for signing in via email and Google, handles session state updates, and exposes hooks to access auth info.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Hook to access authentication context values.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role from session metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth to maintain backward compatibility.
